name: Riggle
summary:
Riggle is a free multiplayer snake arena for desktop and mobile browsers. Players collect food to grow, spend length on boosts, and outmaneuver other snakes in an arena shared by human players and bots. Party links let friends spawn near one another, with friendly fire disabled within the party.

The game supports mouse and keyboard controls on desktop and touch controls on mobile. Guest play requires no account or download; optional accounts reserve player names.
